Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly interpret the search results provided by WebSurfer in Step 1. The search results explicitly stated the film title was "Noc nevesty" (not "Noc Nev sty" as the user typed) and identified the director as "Karel Kachyna". However, the Planner's "Updated Understanding" incorrectly recorded the director's name as "Karel Kachy a" (a garbled version of Kachyna) and the film title as "Noc Nev sty". This initial misidentification of the director's name propagated through all subsequent steps, causing the Planner to search for "Karel Kachy a" instead of "Karel Kachyna", which led to the failure to find the specific marriage year for the first wife (Eliška Kuchařová) because the search queries were based on the wrong name.
